`bacnet-probe`: discover, browse, watch and export BACnet/IP devices — an
interactive TUI and a scriptable CLI.

```sh
brew install regalium-os/tap/bacnet-probe
```

Or download the archive for your platform below, check it against its
`.sha256`, and put `bacnet-probe` on your `PATH`.

See [tools/bacnet-probe](https://github.com/regalium-os/bacnet-rs/tree/main/tools/bacnet-probe)
for usage, and the metrics it exports.
